news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Sam Darnold (hip) avoids fracture, to undergo MRI Thursday
news.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said the team got good initial news on Sam Darnold and they have ruled out a fracture.
news.impact: Darnold was ruled out for the night in the opening drive on Wednesday. He is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Thursday.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) ruled out against Seattle
news.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of the Patriots game against Seattle.
news.impact: Brown went down in the second half after a Seattle DB landed on his ankle, and Brown went back to the locker room soon after for x-rays. The Patriots will lean on Romeo Doubs, Pop Douglas, and Hunter Henry in the passing game with him out.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Andrew Thomas (knee) practices in full Wednesday
news.desc: Andrew Thomas (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.impact: The veteran offensive lineman has had plenty of injury struggles throughout his career, but it looks like he will start out this season healthy, as he was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday. His expected presence will be great for QB Jaxson Dart and RB Cam Skattebo, both of whom will need a sturdy offensive line if they are going to reach their fantasy ceiling this year.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Theo Johnson (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
news.desc: Theo Johnson (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.impact: It looks like the Giants will have Johnson available to play for them on Sunday, as he was able to log a full practice to start the week on Wednesday. He won't carry any fantasy value himself but should serve as a nice depth option for Jaxson Dart moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Wan'Dale Robinson (head) off injury report for Week 1
news.desc: Wan'Dale Robinson (head) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 1's matchup against the New York Jets.
news.impact: As expected, Robinson's head injury is no longer an issue and he carries no injury designation heading into Week 1. He should be a full go against the Jets and projects to be a worthwhile streaming option in PPR formats.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Josh Downs (calf) without injury designation for Sunday
news.desc: Josh Downs (calf) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.impact: Downs is not listed on Indianapolis' injury report heading into Week 1, meaning that his calf injury is no longer an issue and that he should be at full health at this point. Indianapolis' distribution of targets should be something fantasy managers keep a close eye on this weekend, but the 25-year old isn't projected to be a strong fantasy asset on his own to start the season.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
news.desc: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Mitchell was sidelined for a while as he dealt with a hamstring injury, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He will have a chance to play in Week 1, but even if he's active, he's not expected to play more than a depth role for the Chargers in their matchup against the Cardinals.
